claims: Paris Saint-Germain defeated Liverpool 4-0 on aggregate in the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League quarterfinals.
Paris Saint-Germain won 2-0 at Anfield on April 14, 2026.
Paris Saint-Germain won the first leg 2-0 in Paris.
Ousmane Dembélé scored both goals in the second leg (72', 90+1').
Marquinhos blocked a crucial Virgil van Dijk effort.
PSG advanced to their third consecutive Champions League semi-final.
